description.narrative:
The "EmpowerHer Project" aims to reduce inequalities and child marriages in Shamva District, Zimbabwe, by actively engaging 20 young women leaders. This youth-led initiative will create safe spaces for young women and promote their meaningful participation in local governance. The project will conduct community awareness campaigns and advocacy training, targeting both young women and men to foster a culture of gender equality. Activities include EmpowerHer Champion training, community information caravans and a documentary showcasing young women's leadership experiences. By addressing systemic barriers like cultural norms and economic challenges, the project seeks to empower marginalized youth, ultimately reducing the rates of child marriages and inequalities from 50% to 20%. Through collective action, the project will cultivate an environment that champions women's rights and supports young leaders in drivingsustainable community change.

Objectives include: Enhance adolescent girls and young women's participation in decision making and leadership positions by2027. Increasing awareness on Child Marriages and Gender Equality with 5 communities of Shamva District by 2027 Key activities willinvolve EmpowerHer Champion training, community information caravans,and creating a documentary to amplify young women’s voices. These efforts will cultivate transformative change and foster a supportive environment for young women in Shamva.

participating-org.narrative:
Solace Zimbabwe Trust is a youth-led organization dedicated to empowering adolescents and young people aged 10-24 in Shamva District. Our vision is to advocate for and enable youth to access comprehensive, quality health and well-being services tailored to their needs. Our mission focuses on fostering open dialogue surrounding Sexual and Reproductive Health and Rights (SRHR) issues, ensuring young voices are heard in decision-making processes. We aim to provide educational programs, promote climate action, and establish sustainable practices within communities. Our core values emphasize inclusivity, ensuring all young people are represented; active youth participation; and the protection of human rights in health access. We prioritize innovative solutions to health challenges and strengthen collaboration with stakeholders to amplify our impact, ultimately fostering a resilient generation capable of addressing the complexities they face.
Solace Zimbabwe Trust operates under a youth-led governance framework that empowers young people in decision-making. Our Board of Trustees primarily consists of individuals aged 18-35, ensuring that youth voices shape the organization's strategic direction. This board features experts in health, education, and social advocacy. Our operational team is entirely composed of young professionals who manage program implementation, outreach, and community engagement. We prioritize youth involvement atevery project stage, from planning to evaluation, fostering peer support and collaboration. Regular consultations and feedback sessions allow young people to share insights and challenges, keeping our programs relevant and impactful. By centering youth leadership, Solace Zimbabwe Trust fosters an inclusive approach, empowering young individuals to drive meaningful change in their communities while addressing their specific needs and aspirations.
